thesis: Accounting and corporate-action uncertainty prevent a reliable valuation judgment. Both advocates depend on unquantified recurring income and monetization proceeds.
strongest_counterexample: Full-year revenue rose 45.1%, profit doubled and reported REIT catalysts could unlock asset value.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if completed asset monetization reduces gross debt/equity below 80%.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of declining recurring operating profit excluding fair-value gains.
evidence_gaps: Recurring-income bridge, asset-sale proceeds, current debt and price-adjustment reconciliation.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Full-year growth and potential asset monetization warrant investigation
Asset monetization and a REIT catalyst may unlock value, but proceeds and accounting gains must be reconciled against debt and recurring income
